main_text.p: ait τῇ ἡμέρᾳ in numero vnitatis, puto intelligi Kalendas eius menfis, Neptuno facrum diem, lautis epulis & Θεσμοφοριαῖς[?] folitum celebrari. Quare etiam librorum fcripturam non cenfeo mutandam, quæ habet Ποσειδῶν ὢν ϑ[?], nam ita fatis declaratur primus dies menfis Pofideonis, vel quicunque alius eius menfis dies fuit folemnibus Neptuni infignis.

Δεινὸς ᾧ τῇ ἀναςάν[?] & εἰ ταῖς[?] .] Legi, ᾧ εἰ τῇ ἀνα- ςάς κακῶς (vel κακα) εἰπεῖν. Sic alibi accipitur, τὸ ἀνασάς. vt capite ᾧ ἀπεχθ[?]. οἴ & ἐκαλυσεν ᾧ ἀνασάς ἀ μὴ δ[?]ωνιστῆ. Ferri poteft & alrera lectio ἀναςάνῳ[?] , quam ita exponemus. Solet cum aliis fe-dens, de eo qui furrexit (vel verba factutus, vel dif-ceffurus) male loqui.

καὶ ᾧ εἰ τῆ τελεσάτηκότων κακῶς λέγεν·] Hoc qui-dem non folùm in bonos mores committere eft: verùm etiam in ius fcriptum, & leges Athenien-fium. Fuit enim lex Solonis τὸν τεθνηκότα κακῶς μὴ ἀγορεύειν. Atque hæc fatis. Sequebantur in libris Palatinis tituli duo, fed tituli tantum, ita
main_text.head: Περὶ φιλοπονηρίας.
Περὶ ἀσυχροκερδίας.
main_text.p: At in alio codice eiufdem bibliothecæ, quæ ista quinque capita non habet, fubiecta funt characteri oftentatoris, verba cuiufdam femidocti Græculi, Theophraftum hoc modo compellantis.
ἀν᾽ ἐστιν, ὦ Θεόφραστε, χαλεπὸν, καὶ Σαρ[?]ὸς τῶν Ξίστων [?]

page.notes: Greek and mixed Latin-Greek passages are partly blurred: Θεσμοφοριαῖς, Ποσειδῶν ὢν ϑ, the opening Greek line of the second paragraph, and the final Greek line are uncertain and marked [?]. The second paragraph's Greek words are heavily degraded; the reading is my best approximation. The catchword ἰδεῖν is printed below the last line, at right. Two Greek title lines are centred and treated as level 2 headings. The page number 350 is printed top left.
